verdict.rationale: Gram lets teams generate MCP servers from any OpenAPI spec, govern/proxy third-party MCP servers, and discover/import official third-party servers via the MCP Registry (gram-docs-17), with a real-world example of 200+ servers under one gateway (gram-docs-9, gram-docs-28). This shows broad reach into third-party APIs/servers, but there's no evidence of a native pre-built catalog with hundreds-to-thousands of ready integrations akin to a dedicated app marketplace. Missing for 10: explicit catalog size/breadth numbers beyond one customer's 200 servers, and confirmation of a curated large-scale integration marketplace rather than build-your-own-from-OpenAPI or registry-discovery approach.
